# Biting Point — legal pages

The public Privacy Policy and account-deletion page for the Biting Point Android app,
as required by Google Play.

**These files are generated — do not edit them here.** They are built from
`legal_docs/terms_and_conditions.txt` in the app repository by
`tools/build_pages.py`, which also writes the copy shown inside the app and the
copy served from Supabase Storage. Editing the HTML by hand would make this
the one copy that disagrees with the other two.

To update: change the document in the app repository, re-run the generator
with `--out` pointing at a checkout of this repository, and commit the result.

Served by GitHub Pages from the repository root.
